replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
We need map information, a download, XML...

This is an very basic map and honestly just doesn't fit any of the maps we'd have in our rotations. We have a higher standard of quality that would consist of at least more land, more natural shapes, some aesthetics, more variation, better size, and maybe less void.

You also need a spectator spawn for your map, so spectators can spawn in.
